_comment: Gear drops follow what the PLAYER has unlocked (Boss 2026-11-17: gear that drops by level is tied to the world map; if the mummy map is not open yet the game must not drop level-15 gear, it only fills the bag). `zones`: zone id (data/world/zones.json) -> the gear level (catalog req_level) that zone opens up. Unlocked gear level of a profile = the highest value among the zones that are OPEN for it (logic/world_zones.gd state: boss beaten + quest); level 1 is always allowed. The cap applies to EVERY map: while the pyramid is closed, the goblin map drops only level-1 gear; once it is open, goblin and mummy maps both drop levels 1 and 15, and so on. A zone with no entry here (or a bad value) counts as level 1, never as permissive. Level-1 drops are the same catalog pieces with the instance id prefix 'starter-drop-' (they wear at any card level, main stat x1.0, can tier up into the level-15 piece). `level_weights`: gear level (as text) -> weight when a drop picks among the allowed levels; missing = 1 (equal); raise a number to favour that level. PLACEHOLDERS the Boss can change here without code.
_orc_camp: 2026-11-21 PO default: orc_camp = 20, the level its main quest War Drums asks for (one card Lv20, every card Lv10) and the req/drop level of the pyramid boss weapons (catalog boss_mummy_*). No droppable level-20 catalog pieces exist yet, so until a level-20 gear line is added the cap changes nothing in practice (drops stay level 1 / 15; boss weapons and the Orc Warlock set (level 20) are no_drop and never picked as siblings). When orc boss gear is made, give it req_level/drop_level 20.
